title: API: two identical status requests sent at once change the part once and write one history entry
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). QAPL-CAP-030 is active; note its id. After the test send PATCH with "status":"active" for it.
custom_steps:
1. In the DevTools console send the same PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-CAP-030 id>"],"status":"inactive","note":"QA race"} twice at once (two copies of the fetch in one Promise.all).
  2. Read both responses.
  3. GET /api/inventory/parts?status=inactive&search=QAPL-CAP-030.
  4. Open QAPL-CAP-030's Part History.
custom_expected:
1. Both requests complete.
  2. Both 200: one has QAPL-CAP-030 in data.updated; the other has data.updated [] and data.failed with "Part is already in that state."
  3. QAPL-CAP-030 is listed once with is_active: false.
  4. Exactly one "Deactivated | Reason: QA race" entry (no DB access: this stands in for the DB check of one part.status.deactivated row).
